title: codemod-split-protocol: add a pass that moves a member of the landed protocol.ts facade into its facet (it refuses its own output, and the split no longer re-proves from its #29985 base)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

Filing gate: ① tooling gap found by the #30054 dev (PR #30516, os-dev-report 6659827407, open_questions A). Confirmed by the seat from the report's readings. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3.

## What happens

#30054 step 1 (PR #30516) spells the return types of eight `protocol.ts` doors, with the public `.d.ts` byte-equal, so that their bodies can move to facets. Step 2, moving them, is not mechanical with the current tooling:

- `scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs` refuses to run on its own output, i.e. a file it has already split.
- `--verify --base 48914fdc^` no longer re-proves the split: 79/85 and 71/78. Facet modules have been hand-edited since then (#30293, #30353, #30380, #30414), and there are two extra top-level non-facet declarations.

So the eight rows stay in `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`, now with a reason that names this gap.

## Ask

Give the codemod a pass that moves a single member of an already-landed facade into its existing facet module, the way #30055's `--members` pass does for `engine.ts`, and proves the public `.d.ts` byte-equal. Then move the eight bodies and drop their registry rows.

Reader: the facade tooling owner (`scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs`, `scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs`). Links: #30054, PR #30516, #30019, #30055.
